notes: Strip e of plate 22-70: x 6410-7680 plus ~300 px each side. Plate is turned (streets run at about 31 degrees off the grid: the N-S streets Brewster, Clarion, Rutland, Dana run SSE across the page, the cross streets Trimble, Bevis, Wabash, Evanston run ENE). Names read: Montgomery (top edge, name not printed in this strip; 'ROAD' printed near x~6950 per strip d), Brewster (BREWSTER), Clarion (CLARION), Rutland Avenue (RUTLAND AVE.), Dana (DANA), Hudson (S. HUDSON AVE.), Trimble Avenue, Bevis Avenue, Wabash Avenue, Evanston (EVANSTON), Duck Creek Road (DUCK CREEK ... ROAD), Section Avenue (SECTION), Peter (PETER), Lake Avenue (LAKE ... AVE.), Holly Avenue, Lilac (LILAC), Ivy Avenue (IVY ... AVE.), Vista Avenue (VISTA), Garden Place (GARDEN PL.), Madison Road (MADISON ... ROAD). Suffixes not seen for Clarion, Dana, Evanston, Peter, Lilac: I wrote Avenue/Street to match the neighbouring strips. Uncertain: the 'C. AVE.' label on the 50 ft strip west of Duck Creek at Wabash (strip d treats it as Wabash's west leg); the 'PA..' stub off Vista; the '...ST.' stub at Vista's east end. Bevis/Duck Creek (~5980,2416) and Stacey/Brewster (~5985,605) lie more than 300 px west of the strip and are left to strip d. Oliver Lyon's Est., Kerper & Brewster Sub., Hosman's Sub. etc. are subdivision names, not streets. Private sewer-easement strips south of Lake (marked with S symbols) are not counted as streets.
